name: Flintfire's Shipment

angles.text: As a gnome, you are welcome to take on hard physical work in Dun Morogh. Tognus Flintfire appreciates your grit.
The lost shipments are ore the miners left behind when they evacuated their main dig site after the wendigos attacked.
Flintfire's shipments supply Kharanos's local forges with workable metal.

faq.answer: Tognus Flintfire is a dwarf in Kharanos whose forge depends on steady ore shipments. Wendigos overran his primary mining cave, leaving a severe shortage, so he asks travelers to retrieve the abandoned crates.
The Grizzled Den lies west of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. It was a reliable mining site, but savage wendigos now make it their den, and the lost ore remains inside.
faq.q: Where is the Grizzled Den located?

faq.answer: Hostile wendigos invaded and overran the miners' most reliable source of ore. The workers fled in a desperate scramble, leaving equipment and packed shipments behind, but all made it out alive.
faq.q: Why was the mining cave abandoned?

faq.answer: The missing shipments are crates of ore packed before the wendigos drove the miners out. Without it, local metalworking and forge work in Kharanos are threatened with a halt.
faq.q: What is inside the missing shipments?

faq.answer: Tognus says all the miners escaped the Grizzled Den in one piece despite the wendigos' ferocity. They left their supplies and ore behind.
faq.q: Did any miners get hurt during the attack?

faq.answer: The recovered shipments give Tognus Flintfire the raw metal stock to get the local forge working again. That can happen without clearing the entire infested cavern first.
faq.q: What happens once the shipments are recovered?

sections.body: Tognus Flintfire's forge in Kharanos is short of ore. Savage wendigos invaded the Grizzled Den, the region's most productive and dependable source. The miners fled for their lives, leaving their posts and freshly packed crates scattered across the cavern floor.
sections.title: A Supply Crisis in Kharanos

sections.body: The Grizzled Den lies west of Kharanos. Tognus is grateful that every miner escaped the wendigos in one piece, yet the work stoppage threatens to halt local blacksmithing. Rather than wait for an armed expedition to clear the cave, he seeks daring travelers to slip into the wendigo lair, gather the stranded crates, and bring the ore back to his forge.
sections.title: Venturing into the Grizzled Den

summary: Kharanos forges need ore from the Grizzled Den, where savage wendigos have driven miners out. The miners left crates behind, and Tognus Flintfire needs the ore to keep local forges supplied.
